question: 按产品线统计已完成订单的人民币销售额。
description: 两表 Join、维度分组、销售额聚合和状态过滤。
expected_sql:
SELECT p.product_line,
       SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny) AS net_sales_cny
FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line AS f
JOIN mart_sales.dim_product AS p
  ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE f.order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY p.product_line
ORDER BY p.product_line;

question: 按销售区域统计已完成订单数量。
description: 两表 Join、维度分组、订单去重和状态过滤。
expected_sql:
SELECT r.sales_region_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS completed_order_count
FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line AS f
JOIN mart_sales.dim_sales_region AS r
  ON r.sales_region_key = f.sales_region_key
WHERE f.order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY r.sales_region_name
ORDER BY r.sales_region_name;

FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line AS f
JOIN mart_sales.dim_sales_region AS r
  ON r.sales_region_key = f.sales_region_key

ORDER BY r.sales_region_name;

question: 2025 年第一季度已完成订单的人民币销售额是多少？
description: 两表 Join、时间过滤和销售额聚合；按 completion_date_key 关联 dim_date.full_date，按完成日期统计。
expected_sql:
SELECT SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny) AS net_sales_cny
FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line AS f
JOIN mart_sales.dim_date AS d
  ON d.date_key = f.completion_date_key
WHERE f.order_status = 'completed'
  AND d.full_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND d.full_date < DATE '2025-04-01';
